    Bug 1929906 - Fix browser_interactionTelemetry.js. r=arschmitz
    
    This was an unwanted side-effect of D228296. We now enforce and wait for
    focus before clicking an extension button in `clickExtensionButton()`.
    However, this test was already using `SimpleTest.promiseFocus()` before
    clicking one and that somehow collided with the added enforced focus in
    `clickExtensionButton()`.
    
    What I can see is that `Services.focus.focusedWindow` is `null`, even
    though the main window is focused. I do not know why. Removing the
    now no longer needed call of `SimpleTest.promiseFocus()` fixed it.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D228346

diff --git a/mail/base/test/browser/browser_interactionTelemetry.js b/mail/base/test/browser/browser_interactionTelemetry.js
index 41a58b98016..c06a2475ec4 100644
--- a/mail/base/test/browser/browser_interactionTelemetry.js
+++ b/mail/base/test/browser/browser_interactionTelemetry.js
@@ -118,7 +118,6 @@ add_task(async function () {
     "interaction1_mochi_test-composeAction-toolbarbutton"
   );
   await BrowserTestUtils.closeWindow(composeWindow);
-  await SimpleTest.promiseFocus(window);
 
   // Check all of the things we clicked on have been recorded.
   let events = await Glean.mail.uiInteraction.testGetValue();
